newsitem.title: USA: Oryx completes two UK North Sea wells.
newsitem.headline: Oryx completes two UK North Sea wells.

text.p: Oryx Energy Co said on Tuesday it completed the development of two wells in the U.K. North Sea for a total gross production rate of 28,000 barrels per day.
This would push its fourth quarter production over 19 million equivalent barrels, compared to an aggregated 16.1 million equivalent barrels in the same period last year, the company said.
The Murchison M-38 well was tested at a gross production rate of 13,000 barrels per day, Oryx said. Oryx is the operator and 68.55 percent owner of the field.
The Hutton H-38 well was tested at a gross production rate of 15,000 barrels per day, the company said. Oryx is the operator and 58.60 percent owner of this field, it said.
